objective: Preregister 20 candidates for T-20260928-42 (gap-search 2026-09-28-22, flows_structural.rebalance_and_hedging_flows): 8 primary option-expiration-week calendar candidates (OPEX_{SPY,QQQ,DIA,IWM}_{WEEK,WEEKMON}, long-only during the week containing the month's 3rd Friday, cash otherwise) plus 12 internal placebo controls (PLACEBO_W{1,2,4}_{SPY,QQQ,DIA,IWM}, identical construction anchored to non-expiration Friday weeks) for scripts/screen_batch.py --batch h20260928_42_opex_week --iteration h20260928_42_opex_week. No return, Sharpe or backtest number is computed in this dossier.

parameters.rule: Entry: last known trading day (from close.index, the exchange trading-day calendar -- never a price value) before the Monday of the week containing the month's 3rd Friday (standard monthly option expiration), at that day's close -> next trading day's open buy 1.0 SPY. Exit: last known trading day within that same expiration week, at close -> next trading day's open sell (all weight to SHY via the lane's own remainder rule).

Entry: identical to OPEX_SPY_WEEK. Exit deferred: first known trading day of the week AFTER the expiration week, at that day's close -> next trading day's open sell (all to SHY). Captures Garcia-Ares & Muravyev (2025)'s finding that rollover order-imbalance price pressure concentrates on the 3rd Friday AND the following Monday.

data_v1_sip_daily_opex_week_panel.hygiene: drop bars with zero volume and zero trade_count
data_v1_sip_daily_opex_week_panel.source: alpaca SIP daily archive, fully adjusted closes
data_v1_sip_daily_opex_week_panel.confirmed_coverage: SPY, QQQ, DIA, IWM and SHY are already used by S1-S3 and every prior batch-screening round and are present in data/sip/daily/*/*.parquet well before the 2016-05-02 stress-window start; no new data fetch is needed.

feature_v1_opex_week_calendar_rule.definition: Each candidate's weight vector is produced by scripts/screen_batches/h20260928_42_opex_week.py's entry_dates_for_friday/exit_dates_same_week/exit_dates_following_week helpers plus _make_entry_only_weights_fn, using only close.columns (ticker presence) and close.index (the exchange trading-day calendar) -- no price value is read at all, so there is no look-ahead by construction, stronger than the usual close.loc[:asof] convention.

label_v1_close_signal_next_open_fill.definition: signal computed at session close; weights effective at the next session open (next_bar_open fill), matching the frozen S1/S2/S3 convention.

holdout_2026_contaminated: S3's own anchor window already covers part of this range; reference only.
validation_v1_screen_lane_frozen_windows.offsets: D frequency with signal_dates_fn: exactly one version, no rebalance-day offset sweep (per screen_lane.py's own docstring).
validation_v1_screen_lane_frozen_windows.s3_reference_numbers: S3's own date-neutral Sharpe (median over 21 monthly offsets) is 1.49 in the anchor window and 0.81 in the stress window (owner-cited 2026-09-28); K1's bars are 1.19 and 0.65 respectively.

trial_count_and_dsr_note: This batch has 20 preregistered candidates (8 primary + 12 placebo). Per the queue task's own instruction, DSR is reported for the full 20-candidate family (conservative), not just the 8 primary candidates.

keep_rule.K1: date-neutral Sharpe (D freq, single version -- no offset sweep) >= 0.80 * S3's date-neutral Sharpe in BOTH the anchor window (>=1.19) and the stress window (>=0.65), at 10bp per side, with positive CAGR at 20bp per side in both windows. Only the 8 primary (OPEX_*) candidates are eligible.
keep_rule.K2: a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend of the candidate with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH the anchor and stress windows. Only the 8 primary (OPEX_*) candidates are eligible.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window date-neutral Sharpe >= 1.19 (K1's anchor bar) but the stress window does not clear its bar -- forward-tracked only, not a keep. Only primary candidates are eligible.
keep_rule.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe in both windows is >= S3's own (1.49 anchor / 0.81 stress).
keep_rule.pass_requires: K1 OR K2, for a primary (OPEX_*) candidate only.
keep_rule.placebo_internal_falsification: If a primary candidate (OPEX_{TICKER}_WEEK or _WEEKMON) would otherwise be kept (K1, K2, strong_keep, or watch_recent), but ANY of its same-ticker placebo (PLACEBO_W1/W2/W4_{TICKER}) has an anchor-window date-neutral Sharpe >= that primary candidate's OWN WEEK-variant anchor Sharpe, the primary candidate is demoted to 'not kept (placebo replication)' -- the 3rd Friday is not shown to be special relative to an arbitrary week of the month under this cost/fill contract. Placebo candidates themselves are NEVER eligible for K1/K2/strong_keep/watch_recent regardless of their own Sharpe.
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: 20 candidates total (8 primary + 12 placebo); report all regardless of outcome; DSR computed with n_trials=20 (the full family) for any primary candidate that passes, per the queue task's instruction to report DSR conservatively across the whole batch.
